name: Midnight Roots | 200mg Full Moon Chocolate | Sugar Free Milk Chocolate
description: Satisfy your chocolate cravings without the sugar with Midnight Roots Sugar-Free Milk Chocolate Full Moon. Infused with 200mg of premium cannabinoids, this rich and creamy milk chocolate offers a smooth cannabis experience designed for uplifting euphoria and calming relaxation. Perfect for those seeking a sweet treat that aligns with a sugar-conscious lifestyle, it’s an indulgence you can feel good about.
